criteria.label: Implementation
criteria.description: Working features, use of technologies, scalability.

criteria.label: Design & User Experience
criteria.description: Aesthetics, ease of use, responsiveness, accessibility, consistency.

criteria.label: Innovation & Social Impact
criteria.description: Market need and viability, feasibility, clear audience, creative problem-solving.

criteria.label: Pitch & Presentation
criteria.description: Clear explanation, structure, demo effectiveness, Q&A.

criteria.label: Theme Alignment
criteria.description: Goes beyond a basic LLM call; shows understanding of AI concepts.

judging.notes: Main track brief: 'Improve the Future Quality of Life' with a new golden era for vulnerable communities or ageing industries, focused on long-term sustainability. Theme alignment explicitly asks for more than a basic LLM integration.

curator_notes: All 15 prize winners are analyzed records. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively. The National Bank challenge drew many near-identical trading-bias detectors (see the roster), which makes it a visible crowded lane.
